open_points: The RM0486 source does not specify whether LL_CRC_Write_IDR returns any value or status, so the return-value contract of the write function is unresolved.
The RM0486 source does not specify whether LL_CRC_Read_IDR returns the value directly or via an out-parameter, so the read return mechanism is unresolved.

requirements.statement: When the caller invokes LL_CRC_Write_IDR with a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall write the supplied 32-bit value to the IDR field of CRC_IDR.
requirements.verification: The test passes when LL_CRC_Write_IDR called with a supplied 32-bit value writes that value to CRC_IDR.IDR as read back from the register array, and no other register is accessed.

requirements.statement: While the caller invokes LL_CRC_Read_IDR with a valid CRC peripheral instance, the CRC LL driver shall read the CRC_IDR register and return the current 32-bit value stored in the IDR field of CRC_IDR.
requirements.verification: The test passes when LL_CRC_Read_IDR called after LL_CRC_Write_IDR returns the 32-bit value previously written to CRC_IDR.IDR, matching the register array read of the IDR field.
